proposals.evidence: DEDR2559 directly documents Gondi hille, Kodagu ille, Kota il-, Tamil illai and Telugu lēdu in the negative existential family. Survey helle/ille/illa/lēdu preserve their attested endings and generic not gloss, without replacing them by an invented common citation form. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
